description:
Title: Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine

You develop an application that helps you with the inspection of a machine.
After entering the type of the machine, and its serial number, the inspection can begin:
* Questions are asked, and you have to input values.
* Buttons are to be pressed, and values are automatically collected from the machine and shown to you.
* Depending on the results, additional questions are asked (or not).
generated_bpmn_xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/energy-drink-bottling-machine-inspection">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Inspection" name="Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Inspection">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_User" name="You">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Inspection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterMachineDetails</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterInspectionValues</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_PressInspectionButtons</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterAdditionalValues</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Application" name="Application">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AskInspectionQuestions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CollectAndShowMachineValues</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AdditionalQuestions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AskAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_MergeAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Inspection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Inspection" name="Begin inspection"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterMachineDetails" name="Enter machine type and serial number"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AskInspectionQuestions" name="Ask inspection questions"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterInspectionValues" name="Enter inspection values"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PressInspectionButtons" name="Press inspection buttons"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CollectAndShowMachineValues" name="Automatically collect and show machine values"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions" name="Do results require additional questions?" gatewayDirection="Diverging" default="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_AskAdditionalQuestions" name="Ask additional questions"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterAdditionalValues" name="Enter additional values"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeAdditionalQuestions" gatewayDirection="Converging"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Inspection" name="Inspection complete"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToDetails" sourceRef="Start_Inspection" targetRef="Task_EnterMachineDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DetailsToAskQuestions" sourceRef="Task_EnterMachineDetails" targetRef="Task_AskInspectionQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AskQuestionsToEnterValues" sourceRef="Task_AskInspectionQuestions" targetRef="Task_EnterInspectionValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterValuesToPressButtons" sourceRef="Task_EnterInspectionValues" targetRef="Task_PressInspectionButtons"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PressButtonsToCollectValues" sourceRef="Task_PressInspectionButtons" targetRef="Task_CollectAndShowMachineValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectValuesToDecision" sourceRef="Task_CollectAndShowMachineValues" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalQuestionsRequired" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Task_AskAdditionalQuestions">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression>${resultsRequireAdditionalQuestions}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAdditionalQuestions" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Gateway_MergeAdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AskAdditionalToEnterValues" sourceRef="Task_AskAdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Task_EnterAdditionalValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterAdditionalValuesToMerge" sourceRef="Task_EnterAdditionalValues" targetRef="Gateway_MergeAdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MergeToEnd" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeAdditionalQuestions" targetRef="End_Inspection"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
